bio: Boasting a rustic and sleek interior, midnight-blue leather banquettes, chandeliers, and exposed brick adorn the room; a long bar is populated by chatty locals and well-heeled visitors. While the kitchen sticks to beloved Italian classics, it also pivots seamlessly towards a more contemporary approach. This is food that soothes the soul, as in Mom's meatballs, smothered in marinara and grated cheese and sided by a scoop of ricotta and a grilled baguette. Of course, there's also the Italian sausage and chopped broccoli rabe sandwich with melted gouda and parmesan that satisfies the comfort food quotient, too....
